This provisional merge returns to normal review.

Its decision-relevant boundaries are not merge-compatible: against K7_C0004_M_K7_C0006 the current boundary is weak/conflicting (ARI 0.024, normalized cut 0.494) but the union shows a possible internal subdivision (candidate_k=2) that is not aligned with the current two-way structure, and native-view separation is essentially absent (CT 0.012, RNA 0.014, WSI -0.021); against K7_C0007 the boundary is strongly represented (ARI 1.0, within 0.584 vs between 0.172) with WXS strongly separating (0.836) and WXS native membership strongly represented (silhouette 0.788). No supported split or merge alternative is available for this set, and no remaining decision-relevant evidence could change the disposition.

Its decision-relevant boundaries are not merge-compatible: against K7_C0005 the current boundary is well represented (ARI 0.925, within 0.316 vs between 0.106) with directionally coherent weak-positive native separation across all four views (CT 0.135, RNA 0.051, WSI 0.075, WXS 0.034); against K7_C0007 the boundary is weak (ARI -0.036, normalized cut 0.678) but the union is single-cluster-dominated (candidate_k=1) and K7_C0007 is a 4-member set with only nominal, non-robust driver signals. No supported split or merge alternative is available, and no remaining decision-relevant evidence could change the disposition.

K7_C0005 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: strong BAP1 enrichment (10/18 vs 3/85; OR 34.17; q_global=1.49e-03), the only globally robust signal, with no significant VHL or PBRM1 difference, directionally distinct from the VHL/PBRM1-dominated sets.
